title: Fate/strange Fake New Anime Season Announced With Teaser Visual
content: A new Fate/strange Fake anime series has officially been announced, with a teaser visual and the words “New Season Confirmed.” The announcement from the anime’s official account describes the project as a “new series,” while the newly released English-language visual specifically states “New Season Confirmed.” The…
author: Anime Corner

title: Omoi Licenses Love Is the Sweetest Journey Manga, Adds Titan Manga Titles
content: Digital manga publisher Omoi announced on Friday during its panel at Anime NYC that it has licensed Momoshiro and Tomoko Mitsuki's Love Is the Sweetest Journey ( Tabi wa Ui Mono Amai Mono ) manga, and will begin releasing English chapters in 2027.
author: ANN

title: 1 Year Later, Spy x Family Finally Debunks The Main Villain’s Power With a Major Twist
content: It’s been over a year since Spy x Family released Chapter 109, which shook the fandom with Melinda Desmond’s confession. After learning that Melinda is struggling with family issues, Yor suggested that she consult Loid Forger as his patient.
author: ComicBook

title: 38 Years Later, Dragon Ball Is Due Yet Another Backstory For Vegeta With Manga’s Return
content: Dragon Ball Super revived the series after two decades when Akira Toriyama returned with a brand new story for fans. While Toriyama served as the writer of the new manga, Toyotaro continued working with him as the illustrator.
author: ComicBook

title: Chainsaw Man Creator Breaks Silence on Acclaimed One-Shot’s Live-Action
content: Tatsuki Fujimoto is one of the most celebrated manga creators in recent years. While he is best known for Chainsaw Man , he has also created Fire Punch and several acclaimed one-shots. One of his one-shots, Look Back , gained worldwide recognition in 2024 after its anime adaptation.
author: ComicBook

title: Manga Mavericks Books Licenses Midnight Robot, 'Arai-kun & Haruma-senpai' Manga
content: Manga Mavericks Books announced during its Anime NYC panel on Friday that it has licensed the following manga: Title: Midnight Robot ( Yoru no Robot ) Creator: Yōhei Sajita Release: May 2027 Summary: Boys and girls, it's time to get in the robot!

title: Cancelled Shonen Jump Creator Returns With a New Series Ahead of Anime’s Debut
content: It’s no secret among manga fans that Shonen Jump often cancels series for varying reasons. It doesn’t have much to do with the story; rather, sales or viewership matter most to publishers. In February 2024, Shun Numa returned to Weekly Shonen Jump with a new gag humor series, Super Psychic Policeman Chojo .
author: ComicBook

title: Futurama Reveals Season 14 Preview of New Character, Coco Charm (Exclusive)
content: Earlier this month, Hulu welcomed back the world that introduced us to the likes of Fry, Bender, Leela, and the other employees of the Planet Express for its fourteenth season. Rather than releasing all the episodes of this latest season at once, Futurama has instead decided to go with a weekly schedule.
author: ComicBook
